overview.en:
Plan daily work and manage Sunsama tasks, notes and channels through the official OAuth MCP connection.

Organize personal work into an actionable daily or weekly plan. Start with the available tasks and deadlines, then make priorities and proposed changes visible.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Sunsama 官方 OAuth MCP 规划每日工作，管理任务、笔记和频道。

把个人工作整理成可执行的日计划或周计划。从现有任务和截止日期出发，明确优先级与拟议变更。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Review my tasks for today and suggest a realistic priority order.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看我今天的任务，建议合理的优先顺序。

starterPrompts.en: Find overdue or upcoming tasks and prepare a weekly plan.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 找出逾期或即将到期的任务，准备周计划。

starterPrompts.en: Turn these notes into a task draft for me to review.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 把这些笔记整理成任务草稿供我审阅。
